CHEP (Brambles) - Data Analyst (Orlando, FL, Hybrid)

Key Responsibilities
* Analyze complex, high-volume data from various sources using diverse tools and techniques to derive actionable insights.
* Develop and maintain standardized outputs, including visualizations and dashboards.
* Respond to ad-hoc analysis requests by developing new reports or dashboards.
* Support ongoing delivery of regular KPI reports.
* Synthesize analytical findings into meaningful insights for diverse business audiences.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand analytical needs, define requirements, and deliver data-driven insights.
* Continuously improve reporting processes.
* Provide technical support and training on analytical tools and methodologies to business stakeholders.

Key Accountabilities
* Understand complex business challenges; develop analytics aligned with business needs.
* Use statistical experience and business knowledge to solve complex business challenges.
* Interrogate, manipulate and analyze complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality data from varying sources.
* Build engaging and interactive visualizations.
* Provide deep-dive analysis with clear recommendations.
* Work within a squad to define and design Data Analytics tasks (data requirements, output, success criteria, timescales).
* Provide guidance on KPIs and best practice in reporting.
* Embed data analytics in Product solutions.

Skills
* Turning data into insight and recommendations for action.
* Structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data; identifying linkages across disparate data sets.
* Communicating insight to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* 1-3+ years of Data Analytics experience.
* SQL.
* BI tools such as QlikView, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Understanding of Python or transferable coding languages.
Candidates from recent graduates to more experienced considered.

Remote Type: Hybrid Remote
Skills: Adaptability, Critical Thinking, Data Analytics, Data Visualization, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python, SQL Tools, Tableau, Taking Ownership, Teamwork, Understand Customers.
